text: Um dos melhores aplicativos de organização que já usei ❤ Simples de usar, minimalista, não tem anúncios, tem versão pra web, tem espaço para notas e kanban❤ Acho que poderia acrescentar um espaço para hábitos pra ficar completo, e permitir criar mais de um quadro kanban!!
author: Ana Caroline Queiroz
developer_reply: Hi, thank you so much for such positive feedback! We will develop a Kanban board as well later this year :)

text: I really like this app, it was exactly what a was looking for: simple planner with the possibility of setting the duration of my tasks. This app does have some little insures but not something that spoils the experience. I really don't understand why people are not talking about this app when they talk about planning day/week apps.
author: Thaynara Lima
